## Overview

This project harvests the course descriptions of Norwegian higher education institutions: every course DBH lists at the institutions with a config, with teacher education as one frame of them (see ["Frames"](docs/data-files.md#frames)). It takes course codes, years, and semesters as input and produces structured data containing URLs, HTML, and extracted text from course webpages.

**Input:** A dated snapshot of DBH's course list (`dbh_courses()`, see ["Input Data"](docs/data-files.md#input-data-datainputdbh__dateparquet)) with course metadata (institution, course code, year, semester)

**Output:** The same tibble with added course URL, raw HTML, and extracted text

The data are for researchers who study what Norwegian course plans say
(learning outcomes, teaching methods, assessment, reading lists), and this
repository is for those who harvest them, rebuild the data and add
institutions. The published files hold anonymized text only (see
"Data Files" below).

### Pipeline Stages

| Stage | Code | Output |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Course id `{institution}_{course_code_raw}_{year}_{semester}_{status}` | `add_course_id()` (`R/utils.R`) | `course_id` |
| 2. URL from metadata (institution-specific builders; NA where the URL must be discovered) | `add_course_url()` (`R/add_course_url.R`) | `url` |
| 3. URL discovery (USN, UiT, hivolda, UiO, HiOF; optional) | `resolve_course_urls()` (`R/resolve_course_urls.R`) | `url`, checkpoint `data/raw/checkpoint/{inst}/urls/` |
| 4. Fetch HTML with checkpointing, each URL once | `fetch_html_with_checkpoint()` (`R/checkpoint.R`, `R/fetch_html_cols.R`) | `html`, `html_success`, `html_error` |
| 5. Extract text (the page's blocks as text, USN cleanup, PDF text) | `extract_fulltext_from_raw()` (`R/extract_fulltext.R`) | `data/raw/{inst}/{year}/{run}.parquet` (raw harvest) |
| 6. Read each stored page into blocks, per raw partition; the text is the blocks | `partition_blocks()`, `partition_text()` (`R/pipeline.R`) | `extracted_text.RDS` |
| 7. Give each offering its page; anonymize, and deduplicate within each frame | `read_harvest()`, `plan_offerings()`, `frame_plans()` | `course_plans.RDS`, `course_offerings*.RDS` |
| 8. Split each plan into sections | `partition_sections()`, `frame_sections()` | `plan_sections.RDS` |

Stages 1-5 are run per institution by `harvest_institution()`, which dispatches
to a strategy in `R/harvest_strategies.R` (`standard`, `url_discovery`,
`shadow_dom`, `html_pdf_discovery`, `pdf_split`, `json_extract`, `noop`).
`R/institution_config.R` is the single source of truth for each institution:
strategy, the part of the page that holds the plan (`selector`, minus
`exclude`), how a plan's year is known (`plan_years`: `"url"` or
`"current"`), pre/post functions, fetch overrides and the
`section_*` fields. Stages 6-8 and everything after
them are a {targets} pipeline (see ["Rebuilding Derived Data"](docs/rebuilding.md#rebuilding-derived-data)).

The raw harvest is append-only Parquet: every harvest adds one file per
institution and DBH year, `data/raw/{inst}/{year}/{run}.parquet`, with what it
fetched, and no raw file is written twice (see ["Raw Store and Finalized
Releases"](docs/rebuilding.md#raw-store-and-finalized-releases)). The steps after it rebuild everything from it with the current
code, so a changed selector or post function needs `targets::tar_make()`, not a
new harvest. A page is read once into blocks (see ["Blocks and Sections"](docs/sections.md#blocks-and-sections)), and
both the `extracted_text` and the sections are made from them. The raw store
keeps `extracted_text` only for plans that came from a PDF (uis archive plans,
steiner): that text is the raw data there (uis keeps the PDF too since
2026-10-16).

## Quick Start: Running the Pipeline

The main entry points are in `R/harvest.R`:

```{r}
#| eval: false

# Load all pipeline functions
source("R/utils.R")
source("R/add_course_url.R")
source("R/resolve_course_urls.R")
source("R/fetch_html_cols.R")
source("R/extract_fulltext.R")
source("R/section_heading_map.R")
source("R/blocks.R")
source("R/institution_config.R")
source("R/checkpoint.R")
source("R/harvest_strategies.R")
source("R/harvest.R")

# Harvest a single institution: the rows, not saved (a test)
courses <- dbh_courses("teacher_ed")   # the teacher-ed frame; dbh_courses(): all courses
result <- harvest_institution("hivolda", courses)

# Only one year, or ignore the checkpoints and fetch again
result <- harvest_institution("oslomet", courses, year = 2025)
result <- harvest_institution("ntnu", courses, refetch = TRUE)

# Harvest into the raw store (data/raw/{inst}/{year}/{date}.parquet), a run
# per year, newest first: all institutions, or the given ones; without
# `courses`, every course of the latest DBH snapshot (weeks at the slowest
# sites); with `years`, only those years
harvest_all(courses, institutions = "hivolda")
harvest_all(institutions = "ntnu", years = 2025:2020)
harvest_all()

# Fetch again the offerings without a plan, except pages not found
# (docs/harvesting.md "Fetch Ledger and Retries"); run targets::tar_make() first
harvest_all(institutions = "uia", years = 2023, retry = TRUE)
```

The source order matters: `R/institution_config.R` refers to functions defined
in `R/fetch_html_cols.R` and `R/extract_fulltext.R`.

### Packages and Tests

Package versions are pinned with renv: `renv.lock` records R 4.6.1 and every
package the code uses, and R started in this folder loads them from the
project library in `renv/` (activated by `.Rprofile`). On a new machine,
`renv::restore()` installs them. Harvesting USN also needs Chrome or Chromium
on the machine, which chromote drives. After adding a package, record it with
`renv::snapshot()` and commit `renv.lock`.

The tests run with `testthat::test_dir("tests/testthat")`, and on GitHub
Actions for every push and pull request to main
(`.github/workflows/tests.yml`, packages from `renv.lock`). Tests that need
the harvested or built data (only `data/input/` is in git), a browser or external URLs
skip themselves there.

## Data Files

The pipeline writes the data files below; which files are published, which
are internal and why, the privacy check, the input and every variable are in
[Data Files](docs/data-files.md).

**Output files** (of all courses; the teacher-ed frame's in the `teacher_ed/` folders, see ["Frames"](docs/data-files.md#frames)):

- `data/processed/course_offerings.RDS` — published slim dataset: course rows with DBH metadata + `plan_content_id` FK (no url, no text)
- `data/interim/course_offerings_full.RDS` — internal working file: same rows plus `url`, `extracted_text`, `course_plan`, `course_plan_normalized`; the teacher-ed one is used by the course_browser app
- `data/processed/course_plans.RDS` — one row per unique plan per course code per institution, with the offering its text comes from (`source_course_id`)
- `data/processed/plan_sections.RDS` — one row per plan and section, anonymized (see [Section Extraction](docs/sections.md))
